name: Benjamin Evan Ainsworth
bio: Benjamin Evan Ainsworth (born 25 September 2008) is an English actor. He is known for portraying Miles in the Netflix series The Haunting of Bly Manor (2020), William in Disney’s Flora & Ulysses (2021), the voice of Pinocchio in Disney's live-action remake and Mark Critch in the CBC series Son of a Critch. He will portray Link in an upcoming film adaptation of The Legend of Zelda.
